price_response_safeguard_gate.mechanism: Checks historical price variance (coefficient of variation CV_p). If CV_p < 0.05, price changes are prohibited and price elasticity is withheld to prevent ungrounded demand extrapolation.

risk_penalty_monotonicity.mechanism: Strict monotonicity: For any two identical actions i and j where Risk(i) > Risk(j), S(i) < S(j). Negative gross margin triggers explicit -0.20 penalty.

working_capital_constraints.mechanism: Actions requiring procurement budget exceeding available cash reserves are marked infeasible and filtered prior to optimizer resolution.

causal_discovery_precision.mechanism: Granger causality tests are supplemented with domain priors (marketing affects demand, price affects volume; volume cannot cause past price) to eliminate spurious reverse causality.
